# Centre for Multilateral Affairs (CfMA)

> CfMA is a policy research and advocacy organization focused on multilateral affairs, regional integration, and governance in East Africa and the African continent.

Based in Kampala, Uganda, CfMA conducts research and advocacy on critical issues including drug regulation, regional trade integration, digital governance, and human rights. The organization engages with government institutions and multilateral bodies on policy matters affecting East Africa and the broader African continent.

## Key Topics

- Regional Integration
- East Africa
